authn.notes: Clerk JWT + local JWKS pre-warm; provisioning race-safe (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); OTP uses crypto/rand, HMAC-SHA256 stored (no plaintext), constant-time compare, 5-try limit, single-use verified marker, per-(event,email) cooldown.

authz.notes: Organizer/volunteer-admin resolved before serving cached staff payloads; user-scoped queries (WHERE user_id); organizer-only UpdateStatus; volunteer admin-role restricted to organizer. No authz bypasses found.

rate_limiting.notes: FINDING ENV-2026-01: XFF trusted only from loopback -> global-bucket collapse behind prod proxy chain.

idempotency.notes: FINDING ENV-2026-05: key not bound to user/route; body-hash only; response replay includes PII/access_token for 5 min.

object_storage.notes: FINDING ENV-2026-03: unbounded upload size, user-controlled suffix, orphaned objects; content-type enforced via signed presign (mitigated). VerifyImage on cover save nullifies on failure.

email_pipeline.notes: html/template auto-escaping; Resend JSON API (no SMTP header injection); transactional outbox; JetStream MsgID idempotency; Ack/Nak/Term poison handling. Recipients come from verified DB rows only.

client.notes: FINDING ENV-2026-04: next param validation crash. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML/eval/DOMParser sinks. Guest token kept in URL only (no localStorage).

infra.notes: No committed secrets (.env gitignored, .env.local untracked; CI runs gitleaks). Dev-only creds in compose. FINDING ENV-2026-06: no SECURITY.md, no security headers. FINDING ENV-2026-07: health metadata + wildcard CORS.

database.notes: sqlc generated, parameterized queries only (no string-concat SQL found). Capacity guarded via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE. Migration schema not deeply reviewed for data-at-rest (defer to DBA review).

coverage_notes: Coverage is best-effort parent-side (degraded mode). Areas marked reviewed were read directly. Independent investigator separation was not achieved because delegation was unavailable (repeated cancellations/empty results). sqlc-generated DB files excluded.
